invariants.rationale: The method returns either parentProps, templateProps, or a newly created merged element, all of which are non-null at the exit point (since if a parameter is null, the other parameter is returned, and otherwise a merged element is created and returned).
The method only returns templateProps if parentProps is null.
The method only returns parentProps if templateProps is null.
If result is templateProps, then templateProps must be non-null (since the method checks for null before returning it).
If result is parentProps, then parentProps must be non-null (since the method checks for null before returning it).
